req.title: Fetching completed tasks
req.statement: The system shall optionally filter tasks by completed status when a filter query parameter is supplied.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /tasks/?completed=true (or false) must filter tasks by completion status. The pre-loaded dataset has exactly 6 completed tasks (ids 1,2,3,9,15,19) and 14 incomplete tasks (ids 4-8,10-14,16-18,20). Tests cover: (1) positive EP – completed=true returns exactly 6 tasks all with completed==True; (2) positive EP – completed=false returns exactly 14 tasks all with completed==False; (3) negative NEG – invalid non-boolean value for completed returns HTTP 422; (4) BVA – no filter parameter returns all 20 tasks; (5) DT – completed=false combined with limit=1 returns exactly 1 incomplete task; (6) BVA boundary – limit=1 with completed=true returns exactly 1 task. Each test asserts exact counts and field values to kill comparison-flip, constant-bump, and boolean-negation mutations.

actions: POST /tasks/ with completed=true to create task id 21
GET /tasks/?completed=true and verify count is now 7
Verify the new task id appears in the filtered results
expected: POST returns HTTP 201 with completed==True
GET /tasks/?completed=true returns 7 tasks
New task id is present in the filtered list

STC: state changes from 6 completed to 7 completed tasks
Kills mutation that caches or ignores newly inserted rows in filter
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_newly_created_completed_task_appears_in_completed_filter():
    create_r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "New completed task", "completed": True})
    assert create_r.status_code == 201
    new_task = create_r.json()
    assert new_task["completed"] is True
    new_id = new_task["id"]
    get_r = client.get("/tasks/?completed=true")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    tasks = get_r.json()
    assert len(tasks) == 7
    returned_ids = {t["id"] for t in tasks}
    assert new_id in returned_ids
    for t in tasks:
        assert t["completed"] is True
